title: Flanged hub
summary: A 60 mm flange with a 24 mm hub, 12 mm center bore, and four 6 mm bolt holes on a 40 mm pitch circle.
script:
# Complete CadQuery construction.
part_0 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[30, 8])
part_1 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[12, 24])
part_2 = part_0.fuse(part_1).clean()
part_3 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[6, 26])
part_4 = part_3.translate([0, 0, -1])
part_5 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[3, 10])
part_6 = part_5.translate([20, 0, -1])
part_7 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[3, 10])
part_8 = part_7.translate([-20, 0, -1])
part_9 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[3, 10])
part_10 = part_9.translate([0, 20, -1])
part_11 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[3, 10])
part_12 = part_11.translate([0, -20, -1])
part_13 = part_2.cut(part_4, part_6, part_8, part_10, part_12).clean()
result = part_13
